shots.narration_span:
我本来是想招个 AI 替我干活。

第三天以后，

我成了它的入职培训老师。
shots.staging_blocking: IP expected AI to reduce work, but now stands with onboarding materials facing AI like a trainer.
shots.framing_strategy: medium two-shot with work hub context
shots.composition_strategy: IP with manuals foreground, AI waiting opposite.
shots.visual_state: Role reversal: employer becomes trainer.

shots.narration_span: 第一天，我让它帮我查库存。
shots.staging_blocking: IP gestures AI from HUB toward inventory door in HALL.
shots.framing_strategy: medium-wide, show task origin and destination
shots.composition_strategy: Clear path from IP toward first department door.
shots.visual_state: First delegation begins concretely.

shots.narration_span:
它问我：

“库存在哪？”

我说：

“后台。”

“哪个后台？”

“商品后台。”

“怎么查？”
shots.staging_blocking: AI reaches inventory door, repeatedly turns back to IP as each local detail becomes another question.
shots.framing_strategy: medium two-shot/OTS strategy, keep unfamiliar door controls in frame
shots.composition_strategy: AI near door, IP slightly behind; local entry device remains focal anchor.
shots.visual_state: One department generates a chain of integration questions.
acceptance_criteria: do not cut every question at Semantic level

shots.narration_span:
……

行。

我教。

点这里，进这里，搜商品名，再看剩余库存。
shots.staging_blocking: After a silent beat, IP physically demonstrates the local workflow and points through the required steps.
shots.composition_strategy: Hands/door controls/action path dominate, not a checklist card.
shots.visual_state: Manual onboarding solves only this local system.

shots.narration_span:
教完以后效果还不错。

我心想可以。

一个员工培训一次，后面不就省事了吗？
shots.staging_blocking: AI succeeds; IP relaxes and mentally files training as a one-time cost.
shots.framing_strategy: medium reaction with inventory task succeeding behind
shots.composition_strategy: Successful department action background, IP foreground confidence.
shots.visual_state: False belief: train once and future work is easy.

shots.narration_span: 第二天，我让它看看昨天收了多少钱。
shots.staging_blocking: Next day IP casually directs AI toward finance door.
shots.composition_strategy: Reuse corridor geography; finance door now destination.
shots.visual_state: Second task appears routine at first.

shots.narration_span:
它又问：

“在哪看？”

我说：

“财务系统。”

“哪个页面？”

“账单。”

“怎么进？”
shots.staging_blocking: At finance door, the same question pattern returns with different local terms.
shots.composition_strategy: Mirror inventory staging but vary local props/door interface.
shots.visual_state: Repetition reveals the problem is structural.
acceptance_criteria: mirrors S003 without duplicating exact image

shots.narration_span:
我看着它。

有一种非常熟悉的不祥预感。

又教了一遍。
shots.staging_blocking: IP stares with familiar dread, then reluctantly starts another training sequence.
shots.composition_strategy: Reaction first, then training gesture re-enters frame.
shots.visual_state: The second retraining converts coincidence into pattern.

shots.narration_span:
第三天我要它找一份合同。

“合同在哪？”

我已经不想回答了。
shots.staging_blocking: At contract door, AI asks the same kind of entry question; IP visibly gives up responding.
shots.composition_strategy: Third door in same corridor; IP posture deteriorates.
shots.visual_state: Third recurrence locks the pattern.

shots.narration_span:
库存有库存的入口。

财务有财务的入口。

合同有合同的入口。

客服、邮件、项目管理……
shots.staging_blocking: Inventory, finance, contract, support/email/project-management entry differences appear as parallel door states in the same corridor system.
shots.composition_strategy: Common hallway grammar; local handles/forms/labels vary.
shots.visual_state: Different systems expose different local entry conventions.

shots.narration_span:
每多接一个东西，我就得重新给它发一份：

《恭喜入职，这是本部门新员工须知》。
shots.staging_blocking: Each new system adds another department-specific employee handbook to IP's growing stack.
shots.composition_strategy: Manual stack between IP and AI, taller than before.
shots.visual_state: Integration cost becomes physical accumulation.

shots.narration_span:
最离谱的是，这个 AI 明明什么都懂。

你让它写代码，它会。

让它分析合同，它也会。
shots.staging_blocking: AI confidently writes code and analyzes a contract in the HUB, with no entry-friction problem inside tasks it already has access to.
shots.framing_strategy: medium montage using two capability states
shots.composition_strategy: AI remains same character; task props change, not whole world.
shots.visual_state: Model capability is shown to be real.

shots.narration_span:
可一到真正干活的时候，它就站在门口问我：

“门把手在哪？”
shots.subject_priority: AI stuck at unfamiliar door handle
shots.staging_blocking: Despite obvious intelligence, AI stands at a new door asking where the handle/entry is.
shots.composition_strategy: Unfamiliar handle foreground, AI face midground, IP background.
shots.visual_state: Capability vs interoperability friction becomes one image contrast.

shots.narration_span:
后来我发现问题好像不全在它。

主要是我这家公司每个部门都特别有个性。
shots.staging_blocking: IP scans the corridor of different department doors rather than blaming AI alone.
shots.composition_strategy: AI remains calm; IP's gaze travels across door variations.
shots.visual_state: Problem diagnosis shifts from employee to environment.

shots.narration_span:
库存部：

“进门先报商品编号。”

财务部：

“我们这里只认账单 ID。”
shots.staging_blocking: Inventory door and finance door present different local identifiers/requirements in one comparative corridor composition.
shots.composition_strategy: Two doors share composition but differ in local rule props.
shots.visual_state: Different local schemas are visible without a table.

shots.narration_span:
合同部：

“先告诉我文件路径。”

客服部：

“我们的工单状态一共有十四种。”
shots.staging_blocking: Contract and support doors add further incompatible local conventions.
shots.composition_strategy: Continue same corridor grammar with new local props.
shots.visual_state: Variation grows while world stays coherent.
acceptance_criteria: do not imply rules are literally doors

shots.narration_span:
我看了一圈。

很好。

AI 没疯。

我快疯了。
shots.staging_blocking: IP looks across all doors; AI is fine; IP is the one visibly overwhelmed.
shots.composition_strategy: IP centered, mismatched door rules around; AI calm off to side.
shots.visual_state: ‘AI 没疯，我快疯了’ lands through environment and reaction.

shots.narration_span:
我一开始想得很简单：

那我就给它全部学会。
shots.staging_blocking: IP closes reflection and opens a master training binder, committing to teaching everything.
shots.framing_strategy: medium two-shot, binder as focal prop
shots.composition_strategy: Binder enters center between IP and AI.
shots.visual_state: False solution begins as an action.

shots.narration_span:
库存培训一次。

财务培训一次。

合同培训一次。
shots.staging_blocking: Inventory, finance, contract training moments compress into one escalating montage; manual stack grows.
shots.composition_strategy: Repeat body positions, vary department prop and manual.
shots.visual_state: Training effort accumulates without cutting for every spoken noun mechanically.

shots.narration_span:
再来个新软件？

再培训一次。
shots.staging_blocking: A brand-new software door appears; IP immediately receives another blank training manual.
shots.composition_strategy: New door at corridor end, IP manual in foreground.
shots.visual_state: New system resets the manual-learning burden.

shots.narration_span:
理论上没有问题。

只要我这辈子不再安装任何软件。
shots.staging_blocking: IP stares at a 'never install anything again' implication while manual pile remains beside him.
shots.framing_strategy: medium reaction with software shelf/door in background
shots.composition_strategy: IP trapped between manual stack and future tools.
shots.visual_state: Brute-force solution is shown as absurdly non-scalable.

shots.narration_span:
后来有一天，我突然换了个想法。

既然每个部门都要跟这个 AI 打交道，

为什么一定要让 AI 每次重新学一套暗号？

能不能让这些部门，至少在门口挂一块差不多格式的牌子？
shots.subject_priority: IP stops training and studies door interfaces
shots.staging_blocking: IP closes the training binder, walks to the doors, and shifts attention from AI to how departments present themselves.
shots.composition_strategy: Binder leaves foreground; door fronts become primary.
shots.visual_state: Question changes from 'teach AI more' to 'standardize the meeting point'.

shots.narration_span:
比如：

我是谁。

我能帮你做什么。

你要怎么叫我。
shots.staging_blocking: A simple physical placard shows three concise categories: who I am / what I can do / how to call me.
shots.framing_strategy: insert within door context, not full-screen card
shots.composition_strategy: Placard mounted next to real department door; door remains visible.
shots.visual_state: Common description format appears as a story prop.

shots.narration_span:
库存把“查库存”挂出来。

财务把“查账单”挂出来。

文件系统把“读文件”挂出来。
shots.staging_blocking: Inventory, finance, and file-system doors retain different functions but use comparable-format service placards.
shots.composition_strategy: Same placard layout, different capability content.
shots.visual_state: Standardized interface does not erase different business functions.

shots.narration_span:
AI 到一个新地方，不用先拉着我培训半天。

先看牌子。

知道这里有哪些东西能用。

需要哪一个，再按约定的方式去调用。
shots.staging_blocking: At a new door, AI first reads placard, identifies available capability, then uses the indicated entry/call method without IP retraining.
shots.composition_strategy: AI path: door → placard → local action; IP stays distant/inactive.
shots.visual_state: Discovery replaces manual onboarding.

shots.narration_span:
第一次把这套东西接起来以后，我最大的感受其实不是：

“哇，AI 又变聪明了。”

它压根没突然变聪明。

变的是我终于不用每去一个部门，就重新给它办一次入职。
shots.staging_blocking: AI looks exactly the same while manuals are unused and it moves between departments independently.
shots.composition_strategy: No visual intelligence upgrade; only friction objects disappear from use.
shots.visual_state: MCP-like interoperability changes access friction, not model intelligence.

shots.narration_span: 也是到这里，我才真正理解 MCP 这种东西到底在解决什么。
shots.subject_priority: term reveal in existing story world
shots.staging_blocking: MCP term appears only after the standardized door behavior is already understood.
shots.composition_strategy: No new diagram; AI uses the same corridor/placards.
shots.visual_state: Technical name attaches to prior intuition.

shots.narration_span: 它不是给 AI 再加一个更聪明的大脑。
shots.staging_blocking: IP indicates AI's unchanged head/appearance, then points back to interaction pattern.
shots.composition_strategy: AI unchanged; placard/door secondary in frame.
shots.visual_state: Blocks 'MCP makes AI smarter' misconception.

shots.narration_span: 也不是给所有软件装一个万能遥控器。
shots.staging_blocking: Different departments still have distinct doors/functions even with same-format placards.
shots.composition_strategy: Common interface format coexists with different interiors/props.
shots.visual_state: Blocks 'one universal API replaces everything' misconception.

shots.narration_span:
更像是让 AI 应用和外面的系统之间，

终于有了一种比较统一的见面方式。
shots.staging_blocking: AI repeats the same basic approach at two different doors: read description, choose capability, enter/use.
shots.composition_strategy: Same ritual across different doors.
shots.visual_state: Unified meeting method becomes visible behavior.

shots.narration_span:
外部系统可以告诉它：

“我这里有什么工具。”

“有什么资源。”

“你可以怎么用。”
shots.staging_blocking: One concise service placard displays small categories for tools/resources/how-to-use while the actual department remains visible.
shots.framing_strategy: insert nested in real door context
shots.composition_strategy: Keep only minimal category text.
shots.visual_state: Server-side description is legible without becoming a slide.

shots.narration_span: AI 这一边再按这套方式去发现、连接和使用。
shots.staging_blocking: AI reads the service description, selects a capability, and proceeds to use it.
shots.composition_strategy: Placard → action path remains spatially grounded.
shots.visual_state: Client-side behavior is shown as action.
acceptance_criteria: do not imply hidden auth is irrelevant

shots.narration_span:
所以现在别人再跟我说：

“这个 AI 已经很聪明了，为什么还要 MCP？”
shots.staging_blocking: Someone asks why a smart AI still needs MCP; IP glances toward corridor rather than opening an explanation deck.
shots.composition_strategy: Question source off-frame; old corridor visible behind IP.
shots.visual_state: Final answer begins from remembered experience, not lecture.

shots.narration_span:
我第一反应已经不是解释协议了。

我只会想到那几天。
shots.staging_blocking: IP closes any protocol explanation impulse and looks toward old onboarding manuals/doors.
shots.composition_strategy: Manual stack or old door-handle prop re-enters frame.
shots.visual_state: Narrator chooses story memory over technical lecture.

shots.narration_span:
一个什么都会的员工，

每天站在不同部门门口。

等着我过去告诉它——

门把手，

到底在哪。
shots.subject_priority: capable employee at different doors + final handle reveal
shots.staging_blocking: AI stands at successive department doors; final beat lands on IP having to point out the handle/entry again.
shots.composition_strategy: Employee small against corridor, then final handle becomes focal object.
shots.visual_state: Final image restates the entire problem through the door-handle motif.
